summary: CDT Environmental Technology Investment Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K on May 28, 2026, announcing a 1-for-25 share consolidation effective June 1, 2026, to raise the per-share price above Nasdaq's minimum bid requirement. The board approved the consolidation after shareholder authorization on November 26, 2025. No fractional shares will be issued; fractions round up. The authorized share capital is adjusted accordingly. This is a routine reverse stock split to maintain listing compliance, not a special situation. No premium, price, or deal terms are involved; the focus is on the mechanics of the consolidation and continued trading under ticker CDTG.
